flora: Mature Walnut-like trees (broad, spreading crowns, dark rugged trunks)
Scattered fallen nuts on the forest floor
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; a sturdy and established forest feel; emphasis on the 'nut-bearing' nature of the grove; colors reflecting the semi-arid but fertile floodplain.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of an open woodland. The ground is ochre-tinted earth scattered with dark grey stones. The trees are spaced out enough to allow high-key sunlight to reach the forest floor, where several green walnuts have fallen.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, packed ochre clay with a light dusting of pale green-grey silt.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key direct sunlight with long, soft shadows, creating a warm and inviting woodland atmosphere.
